instruction: Please capture the current frame from the video and store it as 'frame_capture.png' on the Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires capturing video frame and saving as 'frame_capture.png' on Desktop. Evaluator checks: (1) file exists, (2) valid PNG, (3) size 10KB-50MB. State-based evaluation.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts file state from the exact path specified in instruction (/home/user/Desktop/frame_capture.png)
Getter validates file is actually a PNG image using 'file' command, not just checking extension
Metric correctly checks all three aspects: file existence (0.4), PNG validity (0.3), and reasonable size (0.3)
Size range (10KB-50MB) is semantically appropriate for video frame screenshots
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements are verified (file exists, correct name, correct location, is PNG)
Logic handles edge cases: missing files, non-PNG files, and size validation
No postconfig needed since file creation persists after agent execution
Data flow is correct: getter extracts properties -> metric validates against expected rules
